theorem_title: The actual five-dimensional rational coefficient map is bijective
formal_statement:
theorem ZetaNine.CoefficientMapKernelBridge.original_five_dimensional_map_bijective (n : ℕ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) (hn : Even n) :
    Function.Bijective (quarticAggregateLinearMap n):= by sorry
natural_language_statement: For each even n>=2 the original five-dimensional rational aggregate map on quartic coordinates is bijective. Injectivity follows from the actual quartic kernel result, then finite dimensionality gives surjectivity. No determinant, rank, bijection or inverse assumption is added.
